full_judgment: 5. The case of the plaintiffs of Title Suit Nos.100 of 1997 and 101 of 1997 (the present leave-petitioners), in short, was that the suit plot No.2721 comprising 10.90 acres of land along with other lands originally belonged to Khoda Boksha in 8 annas share and Sheikh Kalu and Sheikh Malu in 4 annas share each. That Sheikh Malu died leaving behind 2 sons Mainuddin and Newazuddin and 2 daughters Guljan Bibi and Nazibun Nessa. Thereafter, Newazuddin died leaving behind a wife Keti Bibi and one son Romizuddin. That Mainuddin, Guljan Bibi, Nazibun Nessa, Romizuddin and Keti Bibi amicably partitioned their share in plot No.2721 and in S.A. Khatian their share comprising an area of 2.51 acres of land from plot No.2721 was duly record-ed. Romizuddin sold out .31 acre of land in favour of Mainuddin by a registered kabala dated 12.04.1966 and Mainuddin purchased another .1550 acre of land from said Romizuddin by a registered kabala dated 15.06.1966. Thus Mainuddin acquired 1.57 acres of land. Mamuddin sold out .33 acre of land to the plaintiffs by 3 separate registered kabalas dated 05.02.1987 and 09.02.1987. The plaintiffs got possession of their purchased land and they had been possessing the same peace-fully for more than 12 years. But suddenly on 06.05.1994 the defendants Md. Sirajul Islam and others threatened the plaintiffs with dispossession; that it was then disclosed that the defendant No. 1 filed Title Suit No.254 of 1994 against Romizuddin and others and managed a collusive and fraudulent decree and on the basis of that decree the defendant has threatened the plaintiffs with dispossession and hence the suits.
